findings.explanation: The new DELETE /users/<int:user_id> endpoint is protected with @require_role("admin"). Per security-policy.md §2, 'Deleting a user account requires the admin role,' and api-spec.md lists '/users/<id> DELETE admin only'. The @require_role decorator (app/auth.py:69-85) enforces authentication (401 if no valid bearer token) and a role-rank check (ROLE_RANK admin=3), returning 403 for lower roles. This is the sanctioned decorator required by policy §1. The endpoint correctly restricts the destructive operation to admins, satisfying the documented access rule.

evidence.content: Deleting a user account requires the **admin** role.
